outcome: Positive screening for major depressive disorder (using the Edinburgh Postpartum Depression Scale)
cohort: 184 high-risk pregnant women at the Maternity at the Hospital Regional de Sao Jose, SC, Brazil
finding: The frequency of positive screening for major depressive disorder was 37.5% and was statistically associated with non-white skin color, income of less than USD 572,56 per month, and maternal age of less than 18 years or greater than or equal to 35 years.
